parts.text: Some students are investigating the magnification produced by a converging lens. They are using the apparatus shown in Fig. 3.1. Fig. 3.1

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) A student sets the distance u between the illuminated triangle and the lens to 20.0 cm. She moves the screen until a sharp image of the triangle is seen on the screen. The student measures the height of the illuminated triangle h O . 1.5 cm h O = ............................................................... Measure and record, in Table 3.1, the height of the image of the triangle h I on the screen, as shown in Fig. 3.2. [1] Fig. 3.2 Table 3.1 u / cm h I / cm M 20.0 25.0 2.25 35.0 1.10 45.0 0.75 55.0 0.55

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) The student measures the height h I of the image for u values of 25.0 cm, 35.0 cm, 45.0 cm and 55.0 cm. Her results are shown in Table 3.1. For each value of u , calculate and record in Table 3.1 a value for the magnification M . Use the equation M = h I h O and the value of h O from (a) . [1]

parts.label: c
parts.text: (c) Plot a graph of M ( y -axis) against u / cm ( x -axis). [4]

parts.label: d
parts.text: (d) From your graph, determine the value of u when M = 1.0. Show clearly on your graph how you obtained the information. u = ...........................................................[2]
